answer: Persistent attendance escrow: each identity must park a durable onyx token on a fixed knoll—a public slot it can only reclaim after 90 days of uninterrupted signed check-ins, forfeited on any lapse. Operating N puppets costs N concurrent attention streams plus N idle tokens, so an attacker pays linearly in foregone yield and monitoring labor per identity; the voyage from one verified session to many is priced in real time, not detection.
